reply.text: Nice work getting out there for a 5k time trial. A 24:10 is a real number to build from, so let me pull up your running history to see how it compares to your recent runs. Nothing is logged for running yet, so I can't see your earlier runs or a 5k PR to compare against. Your 24:10 is the first benchmark on record, and that's what we'll train from. Log the time trial as a run so I can track how it moves. If you tell me how it felt, whether you held a steady pace or faded late, I can help you read it. Did you run it continuously?
